data.exact_reserve_text: Strengthening of prior period reserves; Historic development includes a mix of prior year releases and deteriorations, and in 2018 gross and net deteriorations occurred.

prior_year_events.event_name: Reinsurance to close of Syndicate 958 into Syndicate 4444
prior_year_events.impact_description: The 2015 year of account for Syndicate 958 was reinsured to close into Syndicate 4444 with effect from 1 January 2018; comparatives for 2017 are pre the RITC and the RITC can distort comparisons and development analysis.
The 2016 year of account of Syndicate 4444 closed with a reported loss of GBP 67.7m.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2018 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 1,547.2m. Management notes a strengthening of prior period reserves as a driver of the 2018 result; the only quantified prior-year development disclosed in the technical notes is a net prior-year adverse development (strengthening) of GBP 21.284m (net of reinsurance). No explicit gross prior-year movement was identified in the notes, and the claims development triangle and an RITC of Syndicate 958 in 2018 constrain gross PYD extraction. The movement was driven by adverse prior-year claim development and large loss development influences (and the group highlights inflation and legal/claims environment risks as contributors). Named 2018 catastrophes (Hurricane Florence, Hurricane Michael and the California wildfires) contributed material catastrophe losses in 2018 but are current-year events rather than prior-year reserve changes.
raw_causal_phrases: Catastrophe event net losses of GBP 84.2m as a result of hurricane's Florence and Michael and the Californian wildfires;
data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year development (PYD) was not explicitly stated in the report. The only quantified PYD available in the technical notes was presented net of reinsurance in the 'Net claims outstanding' run-off table (total net prior-year adverse development (strengthening) of GBP 21.284m) and has therefore been used as a fallback. No explicit gross PYD figure was located. The claims development triangle exists (gross) but is affected by an RITC (Syndicate 958 RITC into Syndicate 4444) and formatting in the PDF made robust extraction of the gross PYD impractical; as a result the gross PYD is null and the net PYD was used (flagged). The 'Marine & Energy' movement in the net run-off table was reported combined; this extraction splits that combined figure equally between Marine and Energy for mapping purposes (approximation). Aggregation/splitting assumptions and use of net figures reduce confidence in per-LOB gross movements.
